show.description: A war hero who chooses domesticity over medals becomes invisible inside his own marriage—dismissed, humiliated, and betrayed by the woman he loves and the family he supports. As emotional cruelty replaces bullets and ambition replaces loyalty, a buried past resurfaces, forcing a gentle husband to confront how far betrayal can push a man before he breaks.
